# Galaxy AI Call Assistant

Samsung’s Galaxy AI Call Assistant has two functions: the text call, to answer without speaking, and simultaneous translation, to talk in another language. The video shows what it's for, how to configure and when to activate.

Maurício Yokoyama Issei video, published on October 27, 2025 (5 min 7 s).
Watch: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ruZVjMpaEZo

_The video and the transcript are in Portuguese. The minutes between brackets, such as [04:12], point to the excerpt of the video._

## The Problem

Sometimes an important call comes to a noisy place or in the middle of a meeting, and you can't talk [00:21]. Another barrier is to resolve something by telephone with someone who speaks another language, for example to book a hotel or close a business [00:42].

## What is Call Assistant

Call Assistant comes with Galaxy AI. It functions as a filter for those who connect, as a conversation transcriptor and as a real-time interpreter [01:03]. It already comes in the phone app, without installing anything [01:03].

## Text Call

In the text call, the AI attends for you, transcribes what the other person says and reads aloud what you type on the screen [01:25]. In addition to practice, it is an accessibility tool for people with speech or hearing difficulties [01:47].

To use, tap "Called by text" on the link screen instead of sliding to meet [01:47]. An AI voice warns another person that the call will be by text, and their screen turns into a chat [02:08].

## Simultaneous translation

The simultaneous translation (Live Translate) translates what you say and what the other person says in real time [02:29]. It works both when you call and when you get the call [02:49].

## To configure

- In the phone app, tap the three menu points, then Settings and Call Wizard [03:11].
- There you connect the text call, choose the language and voice of the AI and create quick answers, such as "I'm in a meeting, I'll call you in 5 minutes" [03:33].
- In the simultaneous translation, activate the function, set your main language and select the other languages you want to use [03:33].

## When to activate each function

The text call is activated before answering, on the call screen [04:15]. Simultaneous translation is the opposite: you attend normally and, with the conversation underway, taps the Call Assistant button [04:15].

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can I take a call without talking?

Yeah. Tap "Called by text" before answering: AI transcribes what a person says and reads what you type [02:08].

### Do I need to install an app?

Nope. The Call Wizard already comes in the phone app [01:03].
